About Reliance Industries Limited
RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED, is a Public Listed Company incorporated in the year 1973 and engaged in the business of Oil Refining and Marketing. As per the latest available financials filed by the company for the year Mar 2026, the total paid-up capital is INR 135,320 million and Authorized capital is INR 490,000 million. The last Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the company was held on 29 August, 2025 and the company has filed their last balance sheet for the period ending on Mar 2026.

The registered office address of this company is 3rd Floor, Maker Chambers Iv, 222 Nariman Point, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021, Email: investor.relations@gmail.com.
